# Dropdown

```tsx
import { dropdownPopupClassName, dropdownBodyClassName, dropdownItemClassName, DropdownItemCheck, DropdownItemIcon, DropdownItemText, Dropdown, DropdownPortal, DropdownTrigger, DropdownContent, DropdownGroup, DropdownItem, DropdownCheckboxItem, DropdownRadioGroup, DropdownRadioItem, DropdownSeparator, DropdownSub, DropdownSubTrigger, DropdownSubContent } from "@s0l/design-system"
```

A menu of actions or options triggered by a button. Mirrors the Figma Dropdown: Type (Actions / Selection Single / Selection Multiple) × Sections (1–4). Mobile=True shows the same menu as the Figma Bottom Sheet.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<Dropdown {...args}>
  <DropdownTrigger render={<Button variant="secondary" />}>
    Open menu
  </DropdownTrigger>
  <DropdownContent
    side={side}
    align={align}
    header={
      showHeader && (
        <InputSearch
          placeholder="Search"
          onKeyDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
        />
      )
    }
    footer={
      showFooter && (
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">
            Clear
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm">Apply</Button>
        </>
      )
    }
  >
    {type === "single" ? (
      <DropdownRadioGroup
        value={value}
        onValueChange={(next) => setValue(next as string)}
      >
        {groups}
      </DropdownRadioGroup>
    ) : (
      groups
    )}
  </DropdownContent>
</Dropdown>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Dropdown component:
- Type=Actions → DropdownItem (+ Sub/SubTrigger for Multi-Level)
- Type=Selection Single → DropdownRadioGroup + DropdownRadioItem
- Type=Selection Multiple → DropdownCheckboxItem
- Sections → DropdownGroup separated by DropdownSeparator
- Show Header / Show Footer → `header` / `footer` on DropdownContent
- Mobile=True → the same parts inside the Bottom Sheet
Desktop is the Base UI Menu. On mobile every part renders on the Bottom Sheet instead (so it can be dragged down to close), and the items are buttons with the menu roles that redo what the Menu did: close on click (actions only, like Base UI), checked state and arrow-key navigation. Submenus open a nested Bottom Sheet.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`Dropdown`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobile?` | `boolean` | Figma Mobile=True: opens as a Bottom Sheet over an overlay. |

`DropdownContent`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `header?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Show Header" (.Dropdown Header: a search field or any slot). |
| `footer?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Show Footer" (.Dropdown Footer: actions or any slot). |

`ItemContentProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icon?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Icon" (Show Icon). |
| `description?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Description" (Show Description). |

`DropdownItem`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `destructive?` | `boolean` | Figma "Destructive". |
| `nested?` | `boolean` | Figma "Nested": indents the item 20px. |

## Types

`DropdownItemContentProps`

## Rules

- Import `DropdownItemCheck` from `@s0l/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
